verses.text: Paul, apostle of Christ Jesus through God will, and Timothy our brother, to di assembly of God wey dey Corinth, with all di saints wey dey all Achaia:
Grace to una and peace from God our Papa and di Lord Jesus Christ.
Blessed be di God and Papa of our Lord Jesus Christ, di Papa of mercies and God of all comfort;
wey dey comfort us for all our affliction, so that we go fit comfort di people wey dey any affliction, with di comfort wey God dey comfort us with.
Because as di sufferings of Christ dey plenty for us, na so our comfort dey plenty through Christ too.
But if dem afflict us, na for una comfort and salvation. If dem comfort us, na for una comfort, wey dey make una endure patiently di same sufferings wey we dey suffer too.
Our hope for una strong, as we know say, as una dey share di sufferings, na so una dey share di comfort too.
Because we no want make una no know, brothers, about our affliction wey happen to us for Asia, say dem weigh us down well well, pass our power, so much say we even lose hope of life.
Yes, we ourselves get di sentence of death inside ourselves, so that we no go trust ourselves, but God wey dey raise di dead,
wey deliver us from so great death, and dey deliver; for whom we don set our hope say e go still deliver us;
as una dey help together for our behalf by una supplication; so that, for di gift wey dem give us through many, many people go give thanks for una behalf.

Because our boasting na this: di testimony of our conscience, say for holiness and sincerity of God, no for fleshly wisdom but for di grace of God, we behave ourselves for di world, and more towards una.
Because we no write any other things to una, than wetin una read or even acknowledge, and I hope say una go acknowledge am reach di end;
as una acknowledge us for part too, say we be una boasting, even as una be our own too, for di day of our Lord Jesus.
For this confidence, I plan to come first to una, so that una go get second benefit;
and pass through una enter Macedonia, and from Macedonia come to una again, and make una send me forward for my journey to Judea.
So when I plan am so, I show fickleness? Or di things wey I purpose, I purpose am according to di flesh, so that with me di “Yes, yes” and di “No, no” go dey?
But as God dey faithful, our word towards una no be “Yes and no.”
Because di Pikin of God, Jesus Christ, wey we preach among una—me, Silvanus, and Timothy—no be “Yes and no,” but for am na “Yes.”
Because however many di promises of God be, for am na di “Yes.” So through am na di “Amen” too, to di glory of God through us.
Now di one wey establish us with una for Christ, and anoint us, na God;
wey seal us too, and give us di down payment of di Spirit for our hearts.
But I call God as witness on my soul, say to spare una, I no come Corinth.
We no dey control una faith, but we be fellow workers with una for una joy. Because una dey stand firm for faith.
But I decide this for myself, say I no go come to una again for sorrow.
Because if I make una sorry, den who go make me glad except di one wey I make sorry?
And I write this very thing to una, so that when I come, I no go get sorrow from di people wey I suppose rejoice about; as I get confidence for una all, say my joy na una all joy.
Because from much affliction and anguish of heart I write to una with many tears; no say make una sorry, but so that una go know di love wey I get for una so much.
But if anybody don cause sorrow, e no cause sorrow to me, but for part—so that I no go press too hard—to una all.
This punishment wey di many give don enough for such person;
so that on di contrary una go rather forgive am and comfort am, so that such person no go dey swallowed up with im too much sorrow.
So I beg una to reaffirm una love towards am.
Because na for this end I write too, so that I go know di proof of una, whether una dey obedient for all things.
Now I forgive whoever una forgive anything too. Because if truly I don forgive anything, I don forgive am for una sake for di presence of Christ,
so that Satan no go gain advantage over us, because we no dey ignorant of im schemes.
Now when I come Troas for di Good News of Christ, and when door open to me for di Lord,
I no get relief for my spirit, because I no find Titus, my brother, but as I take my leave of dem, I go out enter Macedonia.
Now thanks be to God, wey always dey lead us for triumph for Christ, and dey reveal through us di sweet smell of im knowledge for every place.
Because we be sweet smell of Christ to God, among di people wey dey saved, and among di people wey dey perish;
to one na bad smell from death to death; to di other na sweet smell from life to life. Who sufficient for these things?
Because we no be like so many, wey dey sell God word. But as of sincerity, but as of God, for di sight of God, we dey talk for Christ.
We dey begin again to commend ourselves? Or we need, as some need, letters of commendation to una or from una?
Una be our letter, wey dem write for our hearts, wey all men know and read;
as dem dey show say una be letter of Christ, wey we serve, wey dem write no with ink, but with di Spirit of di living God; no for tablets of stone, but for tablets wey be hearts of flesh.
Such confidence we get through Christ towards God;
no say we sufficient by ourselves, to count anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency na from God;
wey make us sufficient as servants of new covenant too; no of di letter, but of di spirit. Because di letter dey kill, but di spirit dey give life.
But if di service of death, wey dem write and engrave on stones, come with glory, so that Israel pikin dem no fit look steadily for Moses face because of di glory of im face, wey dey pass away,
di service of di Spirit no go get much more glory?
Because if di service of condemnation get glory, di service of righteousness pass am well well for glory.
Because for sure wetin dem don make glorious no glorious for this respect, because of di glory wey pass am.
Because if wetin dey pass away dey with glory, much more wetin remain dey for glory.
So as we get such hope, we dey use great boldness of speech,
and no like Moses, wey put veil on im face, so that Israel pikin dem no go look steadily for di end of wetin dey pass away.
But dem minds harden, because until this very day as dem dey read di old covenant di same veil dey remain, dem no reveal to dem say dem don take am away for Christ.
But until this day, when dem dey read Moses, veil dey on dem heart.
But whenever person turn to di Lord, dem go take di veil away.
Now di Lord na di Spirit; and wia di Spirit of di Lord dey, liberty dey there.
But we all, with unveiled face dey see di glory of di Lord like for mirror, dey change into di same image from glory to glory, even as from di Lord, di Spirit.
So as we get this ministry, even as we obtain mercy, we no dey faint.

But we don renounce di hidden things of shame, no dey waka for craftiness, or dey handle God word with deceit, but by di manifestation of di truth dey commend ourselves to every man conscience for di sight of God.
But if our Good News dey veiled, e dey veiled for di people wey dey perish;
inside whom di god of this world don blind di minds of di unbelieving, so that di light of di Good News of di glory of Christ, wey be di image of God, no go shine on dem.
Because we no dey preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as una servants for Jesus sake.
As na God talk, “Light go shine out of darkness,” wey don shine for our hearts, to give di light of di knowledge of di glory of God for di face of Jesus Christ.
But we get this treasure for clay vessels, so that di great power go dey of God, and no from ourselves.
Dem dey press us from every side, yet dem no crush us; we confuse, yet we no despair;
dem dey chase us, yet dem no abandon us; dem strike us down, yet dem no destroy us;
always dey carry for di body di putting to death of di Lord Jesus, so that di life of Jesus go dey revealed for our body too.
Because we wey dey live dey always dey delivered to death for Jesus sake, so that di life of Jesus go dey revealed for our mortal flesh too.
So death dey work for us, but life for una.
But as we get di same spirit of faith, according to wetin dem write, “I believe, and na why I talk.” We believe too, and na why we dey talk too;
as we know say di one wey raise di Lord Jesus go raise us too with Jesus, and go present us with una.
Because all things dey for una sake, so that di grace, as e dey multiply through di many, go make di thanksgiving abound to di glory of God.
So we no dey faint, but though our outward man dey decay, yet our inward man dey renew day by day.
Because our light affliction, wey dey for di moment, dey work for us more and more well well eternal weight of glory;
as we no dey look di things wey dem see, but di things wey dem no see. Because di things wey dem see na temporary, but di things wey dem no see na eternal.
Because we know say if di earthly house of our tent dem destroy am, we get building from God, house wey dem no make with hands, eternal, for di heavens.
Because for sure for this we dey groan, dey long to wear our habitation wey come from heaven;
if so be say as dem don clothe us we no go dey found naked.

Because truly we wey dey for this tent dey groan, as burden dey on us; no say we want make dem remove cloth from us, but say we want make dem clothe us, so that wetin mortal go dey swallowed up by life.
Now di one wey make us for this very thing na God, wey give us di down payment of di Spirit too.
So as we always get good courage, and know say, while we dey home for di body, we dey absent from di Lord;
because we dey waka by faith, no by sight.
We get good courage, I talk, and we willing rather to dey absent from di body, and to dey home with di Lord.
So we make am our aim too, whether home or absent, to please am well.
Because we must all dey revealed before di judgment seat of Christ, so that each one go receive di things for di body, according to wetin e don do, whether good or bad.
As we know di fear of di Lord, we dey persuade men, but God don reveal us; and I hope say dem don reveal us for una consciences too.

Because we no dey commend ourselves to una again, but we dey give una occasion of boasting for our behalf, so that una go get something to answer di people wey dey boast for appearance, and no for heart.
Because whether we dey out of ourselves, na for God; or whether we dey sober mind, na for una.
Because di love of Christ dey press us; because we judge so, say one die for all, so all die;
and e die for all, so that di people wey dey live no go live for demself again, but for di one wey die and rise again for dem sake.
So from now we no know anybody according to di flesh. Even though we don know Christ according to di flesh, yet now we no know am so again.
So if anybody dey for Christ, e na new creation. Di old things don pass away. Look, all things don become new.
But all things na from God, wey reconcile us to imself through Jesus Christ, and give us di ministry of reconciliation;
namely, say God dey for Christ dey reconcile di world to imself, no dey count dem trespasses against dem, and don commit to us di word of reconciliation.
So we be ambassadors for Christ behalf, as if God dey plead through us: we beg una for Christ behalf, make una reconcile with God.
For di one wey no know sin e make am sin for our behalf, so that for am we go become di righteousness of God.
As we dey work together, we plead too say make una no receive di grace of God for nothing,
because e talk, “For acceptable time I listen to you, for day of salvation I help you.” Look, now na di acceptable time. Look, now na di day of salvation.
We no give occasion of stumbling for anything, so that dem no go blame our service,
but for everything dey commend ourselves, as servants of God, for great endurance, for afflictions, for hardships, for distresses,
for beatings, for imprisonments, for riots, for labors, for watchings, for fastings;
for pureness, for knowledge, for perseverance, for kindness, for Holy Spirit, for sincere love,
for di word of truth, for di power of God; by di armor of righteousness for di right hand and for di left,
by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;
as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and look, we dey live; as punished, and no dem kill us;
as sorrowful, yet always dey rejoice; as poor, yet dey make many rich; as people wey get nothing, and yet get all things.
Our mouth open to una, Corinthians. Our heart don enlarge.
No be us restrict una, but una restrict una own affections.
Now in return, I dey talk as to pikin dem, una open una hearts too.
No dey unequally yoked with unbelievers, because wetin fellowship righteousness and iniquity get? Or wetin fellowship light get with darkness?
Wetin agreement Christ get with Belial? Or wetin portion believer get with unbeliever?
Wetin agreement temple of God get with idols? Because una be temple of di living God. Even as God talk, “I go dwell inside dem, and waka inside dem. I go be dem God, and dem go be my people.
So ‘come out from among dem, and separate,’ di Lord talk. ‘No touch unclean thing. I go receive una.
I go be Papa to una. Una go be sons and daughters to me,’ di Lord Almighty talk.”
As we get these promises, beloved, make we clean ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, dey perfect holiness for di fear of God.
Open una hearts to us. We no wrong anybody. We no corrupt anybody. We no take advantage of anybody.
I no dey talk to condemn una, because I don talk before say una dey our hearts to die together and live together.
Great na my boldness of speech towards una. Great na my boasting for una behalf. I full of comfort. I dey overflow with joy for all our affliction.
Because even when we come Macedonia, our flesh no get relief, but dem afflict us from every side. Fightings dey outside. Fear dey inside.
Still, di one wey dey comfort di lowly, God, comfort us by di coming of Titus;
and no be by im coming only, but by di comfort wey dem comfort am with for una, as e tell us una longing, una mourning, una zeal for me; so that I rejoice more.
Because though I make una sorry with my letter, I no regret am, though I regret am before. Because I see say my letter make una sorry, though na only for small time.
I rejoice now, no say dem make una sorry, but say dem make una sorry to repentance. Because dem make una sorry for godly way, so that una no go suffer loss by us for anything.
Because godly sorrow dey work repentance to salvation, wey no dey bring regret. But di sorrow of di world dey work death.

Because look, this very thing, say dem make una sorry for godly way, wetin earnestness e work inside una. Yes, wetin defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vengeance! For everything una show yourselves to be pure for di matter.
So though I write to una, I no do am for di cause of di one wey do wrong, or for di cause of di one wey suffer wrong, but so that una earnest care for us go dey revealed to una for di sight of God.
So we don dey comforted. For our comfort we rejoice more well well for di joy of Titus, because una all don refresh im spirit.
Because if for anything I don boast to am for una behalf, I no dey disappointed. But as we talk all things to una for truth, na so our glorying wey I make before Titus come turn out to be truth.
Im affection dey more towards una, as e dey remember all una obedience, how with fear and trembling una receive am.
I rejoice say for everything I get good courage about una.
Moreover, brothers, we dey make known to una di grace of God wey dem don give for di assemblies of Macedonia;
how for great trial of affliction, di abundance of dem joy and dem deep poverty overflow into di riches of dem generosity.
Because according to dem power, I testify, yes and beyond dem power, dem give by dem own accord,
dey beg us with much entreaty to receive this gift and di fellowship for di service to di saints.
This no be as we hope, but first dem give dem own selves to di Lord, and to us through God will.
So we urge Titus, say as e make beginning before, so e go complete for una this grace too.
But as una dey abound for everything—for faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and for una love to us—make sure say una abound for this grace too.
I no dey talk by way of commandment, but as I dey prove through di earnestness of others di sincerity of una love too.
Because una know di grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, say though e be rich, yet for una sake e become poor, so that una through im poverty go become rich.
I give judgment for this: because this na profitable for una, wey be di first to start one year ago, no only to do, but to dey willing too.
But now complete di doing too, so that as di readiness to dey willing dey, so di completion go dey too from wetin una fit.
Because if di readiness dey, e acceptable according to wetin one get, no according to wetin e no get.
Because e no be say make others dey eased and una distressed,
but by equality. Una abundance for this present time dey supply dem lack, so that dem abundance go become supply for una lack too; so that equality go dey.
As e dey write, “Di one wey gather plenty no get extra; and di one wey gather small no lack.”
But thanks be to God, wey put di same earnest care for una inside Titus heart.
Because e truly accept our exhortation, but as e dey very earnest imself, e go out to una by im own accord.
We don send di brother go with am wey im praise for di Good News don spread through all di assemblies.
No only so, but wey di assemblies appoint too to travel with us for this grace, wey we dey serve to di glory of di Lord imself, and to show our readiness.
We dey avoid this, say make any man no blame us about this abundance wey we dey administer.
As we dey give attention to honorable things, no only for di sight of di Lord, but for di sight of men too.
We don send our brother with dem, wey we don prove many times say e earnest for many things, but now e more earnest, because of di great confidence wey e get for una.
As for Titus, e be my partner and fellow worker for una. As for our brothers, dem be di apostles of di assemblies, di glory of Christ.
So show di proof of una love to dem for di sight of di assemblies, and of our boasting for una behalf.
E truly no necessary for me to write to una about di ministry to di saints,
because I know una readiness, wey I dey boast about for una behalf to dem of Macedonia, say Achaia don prepare for one year now. Una zeal don stir up very many of dem.
But I don send di brothers, so that our boasting for una behalf no go dey for nothing for this respect, so that, just as I talk, una go dey prepared,
so that by any means, if any of Macedonia come with me and find una no ready, we—to no talk of una—go dey disappointed for this confident boasting.

So I think say e necessary to plead with di brothers say make dem go before to una, and arrange before time di generous gift wey una promise before, so that e go ready as matter of generosity, and no of greediness.
Remember this: di one wey plant small go harvest small too. Di one wey plant plenty go harvest plenty too.
Make each man give according as e don decide for im heart, no grudgingly or under compulsion, because God love person wey dey give with joy.
And God fit make all grace abound to una, so that una, as una always get all sufficiency for everything, go abound to every good work.
As e dey write, “E don scatter am abroad. E don give to di poor. Im righteousness remain forever.”
Now make di one wey dey supply seed to di sower and bread for food, supply and multiply una seed for sowing, and increase di fruits of una righteousness;
as una dey enriched for everything to all generosity, wey dey produce through us thanksgiving to God.
Because this service of giving wey una dey do no only dey make up for lack among di saints, but e dey abound through many givings of thanks to God too;
as through di proof wey this service give, dem dey praise God for di obedience of una confession to di Good News of Christ, and for di liberality of una contribution to dem and to all;
while dem themselves too, with supplication for una behalf, dey long for una because of di exceeding grace of God inside una.
Now thanks be to God for im gift wey no fit dem talk!
Now I Paul, myself, dey plead with una by di humility and gentleness of Christ—I wey, when I dey with una, dey lowly among una, but as I dey absent I dey bold towards una.
Yes, I beg una say make I no, when I dey present, show courage with di confidence wey I intend to dey bold with against some, wey think say we dey waka according to di flesh.
Because though we dey waka for di flesh, we no dey wage war according to di flesh;
because di weapons of our warfare no be of di flesh, but mighty before God to throw down strongholds,
dey throw down imaginations and every high thing wey dem lift up against di knowledge of God, and dey bring every thought into captivity to di obedience of Christ;
and dey ready to avenge all disobedience, when una obedience don full.
Una dey look things only as dem dey appear for front of una face? If anybody trust imself say e be Christ own, make e count this again with imself, say even as e be Christ own, na so we be too.
Because even if I boast somewhat more about our authority—wey di Lord give for building una up, and no for throwing una down—I no go dey disappointed.
Because I no want seem like say I dey terrify una by my letters.
Because, “Im letters,” dem talk, “weighty and strong, but im bodily presence weak, and dem despise im speech.”
Make such person consider this, say wetin we be for word by letters when we dey absent, na so we be for deed too when we dey present.

Because we no dey bold to count or compare ourselves with some of di people wey dey commend demself. But dem imself, as dem dey measure demself by demself, and dey compare demself with demself, no get understanding.
But we no go boast beyond proper limits, but within di boundaries of di sphere wey God share to us as measure, to reach even to una.
Because we no dey overextend ourselves, as if we no reach una; because we come even reach una with di Good News of Christ;
no dey boast beyond proper limits for other men labors, but dey hope say as una faith dey grow, una go enlarge us well well for our sphere of influence,
so that we go preach di Good News even to di parts beyond una, no to boast for another person sphere of influence about things wey don ready for our hand.
But “di one wey boast, make e boast for di Lord.”
Because no be di one wey dey commend imself dem approve, but di one wey di Lord commend.
I wish say una go bear with me for small foolishness, but truly una dey bear with me.
Because I dey jealous over una with godly jealousy. Because I marry una to one husband, so that I go present una as pure virgin to Christ.
But I dey fear say somehow, as di serpent deceive Eve with im craftiness, so una minds go dey corrupted from di simplicity and di purity wey dey for Christ.

Because if di one wey come dey preach another Jesus, wey we no preach, or if una receive different spirit, wey una no receive, or different good news, wey una no accept, una dey tolerate am well enough.
Because I reckon say I no dey behind di very best apostles at all.
But though I no skilled for speech, yet I no dey unskilled for knowledge. No, for every way we don dey revealed to una for all things.
Or I commit sin as I humble myself so that una go dey exalted, because I preach God Good News to una free of charge?
I rob other assemblies, dey take wages from dem to serve una.

When I dey with una and I dey need, I no dey burden anybody, because di brothers, when dem come from Macedonia, supply di measure of my need. For everything I keep myself from dey burden una, and I go continue to do so.
As di truth of Christ dey inside me, nobody go stop me from this boasting for di regions of Achaia.
Why? Because I no love una? God know.
But wetin I dey do, na that I go do, so that I go cut off occasion from di people wey want occasion, so that for wetin dem dey boast about, dem go dey found even as we.
Because such men na false apostles, deceitful workers, wey dey pretend as Christ apostles.
And no wonder, because even Satan dey pretend as angel of light.
So e no big thing if im servants dey pretend as servants of righteousness too, wey dem end go dey according to dem works.
I talk again, make nobody think say I foolish. But if so, still receive me as foolish, so that I go boast small too.
Wetin I dey talk, I no dey talk am after di Lord, but as for foolishness, for this confidence of boasting.
As many dey boast after di flesh, I go boast too.
Because una dey bear with di foolish gladly, as una wise yourselves.
Because una dey bear with man if e enslave una, if e devour una, if e take una captive, if e exalt imself, if e strike una for face.
I dey talk by way of disparagement, as if we don dey weak. Yet however anybody bold—I dey talk for foolishness—I bold too.
Dem na Hebrews? Me too. Dem na Israelites? Me too. Dem na Abraham seed? Me too.
Dem na servants of Christ? I dey talk like person wey dey out of himself—I pass dem: for labors more, for prisons more, for stripes beyond measure, for deaths plenty times.
Five times from di Jews I receive 40 stripes minus one.
Three times dem beat me with rods. Once dem stone me. Three times shipwreck happen to me. I don spend one night and one day for di deep.

I don dey for frequent journeys, for perils of rivers, for perils of robbers, for perils from my countrymen, for perils from di Gentiles, for perils for di city, for perils for di wilderness, for perils for di sea, for perils among false brothers;
for labor and travail, for many sleepless nights, for hunger and thirst, for fastings plenty times, for cold and nakedness.
Besides those things wey dey outside, wetin dey press me every day dey, anxiety for all di assemblies.
Who weak, and I no weak? Who dem cause to stumble, and I no dey burn with indignation?
If I must boast, I go boast of di things wey concern my weakness.
Di God and Papa of di Lord Jesus, wey dem bless forever more, know say I no dey lie.
For Damascus di governor under Aretas di king dey guard di city of di Damascenes, dey want arrest me.
Dem let me down inside basket through window by di wall, and I escape im hands.
No doubt e no profitable for me to boast. Because I go come to visions and revelations of di Lord.
I know one man for Christ wey 14 years ago—whether for di body, I no know, or whether out of di body, I no know; God know—such person dem catch up enter di third heaven.
I know such man—whether for di body, or out of di body, I no know; God know—
how dem catch am up enter Paradise, and e hear words wey no fit dem talk, wey e no lawful for man to utter.
For behalf of such person I go boast, but for my own behalf I no go boast, except for my weaknesses.
Because if I want boast, I no go dey foolish; because I go talk di truth. But I hold back, so that nobody go count me pass wetin e see for me, or hear from me.
Because of di exceeding greatness of di revelations, so that I no go dey exalted too much, dem give me thorn for di flesh, messenger of Satan to torment me, so that I no go dey exalted too much.
About this thing, I beg di Lord three times say make e leave me.
E don talk to me, “My grace sufficient for you, because my power dey perfect for weakness.” So I go most gladly rather glory for my weaknesses, so that di power of Christ go rest on me.
So I dey take pleasure for weaknesses, for injuries, for necessities, for persecutions, for distresses, for Christ sake. Because when I weak, na den I strong.
I don become foolish for boasting. Una force me, because una suppose commend me, because for nothing I no dey inferior to di very best apostles, though I be nothing.
Truly di signs of apostle dem work among una with all patience, with signs and wonders and mighty works.
Because wetin dey wey una dey inferior to di rest of di assemblies, except say I myself no be burden to una? Forgive me this wrong.

Look, this na di third time I ready to come to una, and I no go be burden to una; because I no dey seek una possessions, but una. Because di pikin dem no suppose save up for di parents, but di parents for di pikin dem.
I go most gladly spend and dem go spend me for una souls. If I love una more well well, dem love me less?
But make e be so, I no burden una; but, as I dey crafty, I catch una with deception.
I take advantage of una by any of di people wey I send to una?
I urge Titus, and I send di brother with am. Titus take any advantage of una? We no waka for di same spirit? We no waka for di same steps?
Again, una think say we dey excuse ourselves to una? For di sight of God we dey talk for Christ. But all things, beloved, na for una edifying.

Because I dey fear say by any means, when I come, I go find una no di way wey I want, and say una go find me as una no want; say by any means strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slanders, whisperings, proud thoughts, riots go dey;
say when I come again, my God go humble me before una, and I go mourn for many of di people wey don sin before, and no repent of di uncleanness and sexual immorality and lustfulness wey dem commit.
This na di third time I dey come to una. “For di mouth of two or three witnesses every word go dey established.”
I don warn before, and I dey warn again, as when I dey present di second time, so now, as I dey absent I write to di people wey don sin before, and to all di rest, say if I come again, I no go spare;
as una dey look for proof of Christ wey dey talk inside me; wey no weak towards una, but powerful inside una.
Because e dey crucified through weakness, yet e dey live through di power of God. Because we weak inside am too, but we go live with am through di power of God towards una.
Test una own selves, whether una dey for di faith. Test una own selves. Or una no know about una own selves, say Jesus Christ dey inside una?—unless truly dem don disqualify una.
But I hope say una go know say dem no disqualify us.
Now I pray to God say una no go do evil; no say we go appear approved, but say una go do wetin honorable, though we fit be like disqualified.
Because we no fit do anything against di truth, but for di truth.
Because we rejoice when we weak, and una strong. This na wetin we pray for too, even una perfecting.
For this reason I write these things while I dey absent, so that I no go, when I dey present, deal sharply, according to di authority wey di Lord give me for building up, and no for tearing down.
Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Get di same mind. Live in peace, and di God of love and peace go dey with una.
Greet each other with holy kiss.
All di saints dey greet una.
Di grace of di Lord Jesus Christ, God love, and di fellowship of Holy Spirit dey with all of una. Amen.
